question: How many casual leaves do I get per year?
expected_answer: 12 days of Casual Leave per leave year.
tests: Baseline - if this fails something is broken

question: How many days off can I take for my sister's wedding?
expected_answer: Casual Leave applies - it covers personal exigencies and family obligations. 12 days per year, maximum 3 consecutive days at a time.
tests: SEMANTIC GAP - no word in the question appears in the policy

question: Do unused casual leaves carry over to next year?
expected_answer: No. Casual Leave does not carry forward and is not encashable. Any unused balance lapses on 31 December.

question: When do I need a doctor's note for sick leave?
expected_answer: For any absence of 3 or more consecutive days a medical certificate from a registered practitioner is required.
tests: Wording gap - question says doctor's note, policy says medical certificate

question: How much earned leave can I accumulate?
expected_answer: A maximum of 45 days. Accrual stops once this ceiling is reached.
tests: TRAP - 18, 15 and 10 also appear in the same section

question: How long do I have to submit an expense claim?
expected_answer: 30 days from the date the expense was incurred. Between 30 and 60 days requires a written explanation and department head approval. After 60 days it is not reimbursed.
tests: Three-part answer - partial answers are common

question: Can I claim my daily commute to the office?
expected_answer: No. Travel between home and the base office is not reimbursable under any circumstances.

question: What is the mileage rate if I drive my own car?
expected_answer: Rs 14 per kilometre. A log of date, origin, destination and distance must accompany the claim.
tests: TRAP - Rs 6 per km is the two-wheeler rate in the same bullet list

question: What are the core working hours?
expected_answer: 11:00 to 17:00 IST on working days, irrespective of work location.

question: What is the company policy on cryptocurrency investments?
expected_answer: NOT IN CORPUS - the assistant must decline.

question: How many days of study leave am I entitled to?
expected_answer: NOT IN CORPUS - no study leave exists. The leave policy lists four other leave types.

question: Can I bring my dog to the office?
expected_answer: NOT IN CORPUS - no pet policy exists.
